//: Type-level test config. The root tsconfig excludes `test/` (and CI's `tsc --noEmit` runs that root config), which made every `expectTypeOf` assertion in the suite inert. This config adds ONLY `*.test-d.ts` files on top of `src/`, so type-level assertions are actually checked without signing the whole `test/` tree up for type checking in one step. Run via `pnpm run test:types`.
